description: SYNTHETIC. Verbatim extract of the frozen WP6 simulation manifest used by the degenerate-data regression tests in tests/test_wp7_release.py: the first conforming T1, T2 and T3 cell definitions, the adverse-condition parameters, and the non-null effect values (the descriptive status note is omitted). The full manifest is not part of this repository.

T2_conforming.note: w = s = 1: the naive site-level analysis coincides with the correct one

missing_sites.rationale: D-019 proposal: sporadic loss; no resampling to save a wafer.

unequal_variances_4to1.rationale: Brief 3.3 minimum ratio, applied only to the top random component.

heavy_tails.rationale: D-019 proposal: finite variance, no finite fourth moment.

outliers.rationale: D-019 proposal: rare one-sided contamination, not recentered.

drift_in_run_order.rationale: D-019 proposal: symmetric fixed drift across the full processing order.

partial_confounding.rationale: D-019 3:1/1:3 allocation; T3 extends it to four A levels.

complete_confounding.rationale: Distinct centered chamber/day offsets; structure decides refusal.

blocking.rationale: Focused D-063 checks; fixed block cancels from balanced treatment contrasts.

T2_treatment_difference.definition: 1 x run-level SD, sqrt(sigma2_run), the same in every w, s cell; tau = d x (1/2, -1/2)

T3_A.definition: 1 x whole-plot SD sqrt(sigma2_wholeplot); alpha = d x (3/4, -1/4, -1/4, -1/4)

T3_B.definition: 1 x subplot SD sqrt(sigma2_subplot); beta = d x (3/4, -1/4, -1/4, -1/4)

T3_AB.definition: gamma_ik = (d/4) c_i d_k with c = d = (1, -1, 0, 0), d = 1 x subplot SD; contrast A1B1 - A1B2 - A2B1 + A2B2 = d
